Scoring 2 hits within 3 seconds of each causes the next shot fired within 3 seconds to have an Explosive Payload. Explosive Payload deals <pve 122 /> <pvp [?] /> additional damage over 4 meters. 

Hits with this Payload grant 8%? additional progress to Latent Power.

Scoring 2 hits within 3 seconds of each causes the next shot fired within 3 seconds to have an Explosive Payload. Explosive Payload deals <pve 122 /> <pvp [?] /> additional damage over 4 meters, which deals 50% reduced damage at the edge of its radius.

Hits with this Payload grant 8%? additional progress to Latent Power.
